metadata.description: Curated demo subset of art_pHL7LWNhpcCS (iteration 7, 'Does one early token decide the algorithm?'): dataset p2_directions of method_out.json, all 80 rows (40 random push directions x tasks T10, T2), joined with the full-precision committed predictors (commit #3b), the outcome counts (f_cells) and T10's fork-token probabilities.

fields.output: y = correct programs labelled a non-default catalogue algorithm / N (rounded string)
fields.metadata_committed_predictors.m: fork margin m in nats (T10: logit of the escape probability at the forks; T2: 48-token opening LLR, the pre-declared fallback)
fields.metadata_committed_predictors.b: projection of the push displacement on the default-to-runner-up axis at block L_ax (P2 predictor); b_L = the same at blocks 12-35
fields.metadata_committed_predictors.pi_Pt / no: competitors of b: P_t subspace energy share, raw displacement norm, U4 energy share
fields.metadata_outcome: outcome counts of the pushed cell (n programs, k correct off-default, attempted, pass, label counts)
fields.metadata_fork_token_probs: T10 only: p(token) of every mapped fork token at generated tokens 10 and 11, per prompt template W1-W5, teacher-forced along the default opening

forks_T2.fallback: 48-token opening LLR is this task's margin (pre-declared); 'no single fork'
